ValidationRule.description: Lost Reason Context is required once opp is closed (only if Deal Date is filled in)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsClosed = True, IsWon = FALSE, ISCHANGED(StageName), RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Partner", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Churn_Contraction_Risk", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Expansion_Upsell", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Organic_Growth", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Renewal", ISBLANK(Lost_Reason_Context__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Deal_Date__c)) )
